name: @vayusetu/gcp-clients
description: Typed Firestore, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery client wrappers shared by every VayuSetu backend service. Centralizes GCP SDK initialization (Application Default Credentials in Cloud Run, emulator hosts locally) and the Pub/Sub event-payload contract from API_CONTRACTS.md §4.3, so no two services construct a client -- or a topic payload shape -- differently.
